prompt:
GOAL: For the member whose member number is [param:member_id], open a new sub-account of type [param:share_type] with nickname [param:nickname], funded by a cash deposit of [param:initial_deposit]. Review the details, submit the request, and read the confirmation number shown on the final confirmation screen.

INPUTS (use via the `input` argument; values are masked):
- member_id (string): Member number as issued by the credit union.
- share_type (enum): Product type of the new share.
- nickname (string): Member-facing nickname for the share (letters, digits and spaces).
- initial_deposit (money): Opening cash deposit in USD.

DECLARED OUTPUTS (extract each one):
- confirmation_number (string): Confirmation number issued by the core for the new share. [pending]

TURN 4 of at most 25

HISTORY (most recent last):
1. click link "Sub-Account Maintenance" -> main: /cb/mbr_search.asp "Member Inquiry"
2. fill textbox Member Number with {{member_id}}
3. click button "Search" -> same page, 6 new item(s) appeared

CURRENT SCREEN:
## frame (top) path=/cb/main.asp
## frame "banner" path=/cb/banner.asp heading="Alpha Community Credit Union CoreBank Teller Workstation"
  [e1] "Alpha Community Credit Union CoreBank Teller Workstation" | [e2] "User: [secret:corebank.username] Meridian CoreBank v4.2.1"
## frame "nav" path=/cb/nav.asp heading="Functions"
  [e3] "Functions"
  [e4] link "Member Inquiry"
  [e5] link "Sub-Account Maintenance"
  [e6] link "Reports"
  [e7] link "Sign Off"
## frame "main" path=/cb/mbr_search.asp heading="Member Inquiry"
  [e8] "Member Inquiry"
  [e9] "Member Number:" | [e10] textbox label="Member Number:" value="[param:member_id]" | [e11] button "Search"
  [e12] "Member #" | [e13] "Name" | [e14] "Status"
  [e15] "[param:member_id]" | [e16] "[REDACTED]" | [e17] "Active" | [e18] link "View"
